# robots.txt for paulwerner.net
#
# This file governs paulwerner.net only. robots.txt is per-host: a crawler
# fetches it from the host it is about to crawl, so rules written here can
# never apply to another hostname. Future demo or staging subdomains are
# therefore excluded by serving their own robots.txt from their own host —
# a Caddy site block for demo.paulwerner.net returning
#
#     User-agent: *
#     Disallow: /
#
# is the whole change. Nothing in this file needs rewriting for that.
#
# The blog subdomain publishes its own robots.txt and sitemap, generated by
# Ghost.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://paulwerner.net/sitemap.xml
